messages:
nina: FYI — PulseReseller wants a co-sell starter kit. They asked for partner entitlement codes, partner API keys, and a short note on embedding vs generation pricing so their sales reps can quote quickly. Can eng help assemble?

carlos (PulseReseller): Hey all! Weneed something concise for our reps: 1) pricing per embedding unit 2) example monthly quote for a 10k user org (search-heavy) 3) max rps and soft throttles so we can set expectations. Pilot planned for mid-May.

tina: Quick Q: do they want Hosted or Dedicated for the co-sell pilot? Embedded-search workloads (lots of small embedding calls) are usually cheaper on Hosted with caching.

liam: From sales: Pulse prefers Hosted initially. They care about predictable token cost for embeddings + a burst buffer for demo days.

mukund: Security note: partner API keys must be scoped & time-limited. We should provide partner entitlement codes that map to rate-limit buckets and telemetry tags. Also include how we redact PII in logs.

nina: Proposed deliverables: A one-page pricing cheat sheet for reps, a partner entitlement mapping (codes -> quotas), and a short ops note on TTL-limited partner keys + telemetry labels. Who takes which?

carlos (PulseReseller): We can accept a 30-day demo key with quota 200k embeddings/day and 2000 generation tokens/day for hybrid features. That should cover evaluation.

tina: I'll draft entitlement mappings. Example mapping to include:
```
ENT-PULSE-BASIC -> embeddings:100k/day, gen_tokens:2k/day, burst:50rps
ENT-PULSE-PILOT -> embeddings:200k/day, gen_tokens:10k/day, burst:150rps
```
Also note caching: prefix caching for embeddings can cut calls by ~40% for search use-cases.

liam: For the pricing cheat sheet I'll prepare two lines: per-embedding-unit price (hosted) and per-generation-token price, plus an illustrative monthly example. Carlos — can you give rough monthly MAU for their 10k user org (search ops per user)?

carlos (PulseReseller): Assume 10k users, 30% active daily, each active user triggers ~3 embedding calls/day on average. So ~9k embeddings/day. Peak demo days could be 5x.

liam: Okay. Example calc (draft):
- embeddings: $0.0007 per embedding -> 9k/day -> ~$6.3/day -> ~$189/month
- generation: minimal for search UI, add buffer -> ~$30/month
- pilot discounts & partner margin apply. I'll produce a table with no-commit rate vs partner-discounted pilot.

mukund: Add security snippet for reps to send to customers: "Partner keys are scoped, rotate after 7 days for pilots. Logs redact user content; metadata retained 90 days. For Private deployments, HSM-backed keys available."

tina: Ops note for entitlement codes: include how to provision via CLI and via Console. CLI example to create partner key:
```
redwood-cli partner create-key --partner pulse-reseller --entitlement ENT-PULSE-PILOT --expires 2024-06-30
```
Console: Admins -> Partners -> Create Key -> select entitlement -> set TTL.

nina: Great. Two blockers: 1) Billing needs partner margin % to generate partner invoice line items 2) Network needs a published list of egress hostnames for their demo environments.

billing-bot: Please file billing ticket #INC-4521 with partner margin details. Use template: Partner margin %, pilot discount %, invoice code prefix.

liam: I'll loop in finance and propose 15% partner margin for the pilot and a 20% pilot discount. @nina can you OK?

nina: OK to propose 15/20. Finance will sign off.

carlos (PulseReseller): For egress, their infra team will accept hostnames, better than CIDRs. Do you have stable hostnames for API & CDN endpoints?

tina: Publishable hostnames: api.redwood.ai, cdn.redwood.ai, telemetry.redwood.ai. We'll note that underlying IPs may change; recommend allowing hostnames or outbound DNS allowlist.

mukund: Also include TLS fingerprinting guidance if network insists on IP locking, but we prefer hostname allowlist.

liam: I'll assemble the cheat sheet, entitlement table, CLI snippets, and security blurb into a single PDF and share a partner-facing doc link. ETA EOD tomorrow.

nina: Thanks. Quick sync Friday 9am PT to review before we hand to PulseReseller. :thumbsup:

carlos (PulseReseller): Perfect. Appreciate the fast follow-up — Pulse team will prep SSO metadata and legal-lite addendum asks.

billing-bot: Created billing ticket INC-4521 at 2111112900

nina: Closing note: for the monthly example, let's include a conservative cache hit assumption (30%) so partners don't underquote.

liam: Adding cache hit line to the example. Will ping when doc ready.
